title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics - telemetry enrichment, runbook ranking, on-call helpers
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot diagnostics: richer telemetry for SLO context, improved runbook ranking heuristics, new on-call helper commands and migration script for runbook metadata.
description:
Motivation: On recent incidents the oncall flow lacked quick access to the most relevant runbooks and telemetry context (SLO buckets, recent regressions). This PR enriches incident-bot diagnostics with additional telemetry hooks, improves runbook ranking, and adds small on-call helper commands to speed TTR. This change affects incident-bot and the slo-toolkit helper APIs but is backward compatible.

Summary of changes: adds telemetry_enricher to attach SLO context and recent-error-signatures; implements runbook ranking with signals: SLO match score, recent successful remediation count, time-since-last-runbook-use; exposes two lightweight slash commands (/diag <incident-id>, /runbook-suggest <query>) for chat ops; updates runbook metadata schema with optional fields (last_run_count, remediation_score) and provides a migration helper; adds unit and integration tests and E2E coverage for Slack flow.

Checklist: - [x] Telemetry enrichment implementation and unit tests - [x] Runbook ranking algorithm + benchmarks (microbenchmarks included) - [x] On-call helper commands and argument parsing - [x] Migration helper script for runbook metadata - [x] Integration tests for Slack/Teams path - [x] Docs update in incident-bot/README and runbook metadata reference

Impact/risk: low to medium. New optional runbook metadata fields are ignored if absent. The migration helper is provided but not auto-run. Feature gated behind config: INCIDENT_BOT_DIAGS_V2.

Related: ENG-3921 (runbook relevance improvements), ENG-4078 (oncall workflow optimizations), SUP-1849 (customer incident requesting better runbook surfacing).

review_comments: Samir Patel (2026-02-16): Nice work. Two questions: 1) can the ranker be tuned without a deploy? (config knobs) 2) add more unit tests around ties in scoring.
Priya Desai (2026-02-16): Answered: added feature flags and config knobs (ranker.weights) and expanded unit tests for tie-breakers.
Ellen Zhao (2026-02-17): Can we avoid pulling full telemetry payloads synchronously in the command path? Suggest async enrichment and a short-circuit cache for frequently accessed incidents.

Priya Desai (2026-02-18): Updated: telemetry enrichment now runs async for chat commands; immediate shallow context is returned while full context updates in background. Added short TTL cache for recent incidents.
Marcus Lee (2026-02-19): Integration test flaked on CI, reproduces locally with race condition in runbook usage counter update. Please add a retry/backoff in the counter update path.
Priya Desai (2026-02-20): Fixed: added optimistic locking + retry with exponential backoff and updated tests to simulate concurrent updates.
